status: Installed on node 172.16.16.17 at the user's request, after rehearsals on the nested PVE lab. Not published.
what: The PVE Console entry is rendered by the shared pve-ui-overlays package instead of qsm-pve-direct's own dpkg-divert, so qsm-pve-direct and qdev-host-pve coexist in any install order. The upgrade takes the template diversion over from older qsm-pve-direct versions and removes the retired injector's bytecode cache and state (preinst and postinst).

The signal service accepts a PVE cluster CA without the key usage extension under Python 3.13. Clusters first installed with an older PVE have such a CA, and every ticket check failed with 502 'authority unavailable' (172.16.16.17, CA from 2022).
build: The same recipe as exp223: core on 172.16.16.200 in /var/tmp/qsm-dev-trixie (browser_bridge and signal unit tests pass in the chroot, Python 3.13), standalone and gateway there, portable Qt guest packages in /var/tmp/qsm-qt-bookworm-20261028 on the controller, then the LXC helper with that Qt deb. Scripts in dist/rdp-hybrid/deployment-exp227-20261108.

installed_on_the_node.before: qsm-pve-direct and -lxc 0.4.0+stock4.14~exp26 with their own template diversion, and the patched pve-manager 9.2.21 with the native viewer left from the older native preview. No standalone profile.
installed_on_the_node.after: The official pve-manager 9.2.21 reinstalled from download.proxmox.com; qsm-pve-direct, -lxc and -standalone 0.4.0+stock4.14~exp227; signalling on TCP 18007; pve-ui-overlays owns the template (active; overlays: qsm-pve-direct, qdev-host).
installed_on_the_node.kept: qemu-server 9.2.11+shared3, pve-container 6.1.14+webrtc2 and libpve-guest-common-perl 6.0.5+webrtc1 from the native preview, as on 192.168.64.20: VMs 100 and 145 still use dbus-display and audio driver=dbus, which the official qemu-server does not parse. apt upgrade would replace these packages (candidates 9.2.15, 6.1.18, 6.0.7) and break those two VM configs until they are converted.
installed_on_the_node.intermediate: exp226 was first installed with the patched pve-manager kept, following the guide's section for patched shared-platform nodes. That was the wrong profile for this node: the solution uses official Proxmox packages. Corrected the same day.
installed_on_the_node.unchanged: Boot, every VM and CT process except test VM 990, dpkg audit empty. pveproxy and pvedaemon restarted once for the pve-manager reinstall; QSM services restarted with no console open.

lab_rehearsal.stand: lab/proxmox9 nested PVE 9.2.21, started without VirGL
steps: The .17 package set reproduced (exp26 + pve-ui-overlays + qdev-host-pve, alongside-legacy), exp226 upgrade: takeover, no dpkg warning, no leftovers; native console of VM 106 3/3, again after a reboot.

Correction rehearsed from the .17 state: apt install --reinstall pve-manager=9.2.21 from the Proxmox repository, then qsm-pve-direct-standalone. Standalone popup of VM 104 (private QSM Display1) and embedded + window for VMs 104 and 106 (dbus-display), again after a reboot and after the exp227 upgrade. QSM Display1 switched off and on through Hardware > Display returns the same VM config.
qdev-host Hardware panel dry run on q35 VM 105 in every state.
lab_rehearsal.also_checked: Removing and reinstalling qsm with qdev present gives byte-identical pages. A pve-manager reinstall re-renders through the trigger. A downgrade to exp26 installs but cannot re-divert the template while pve-ui-overlays holds it; the recovery in ROLLBACK.txt returns to the alongside-legacy state.
lab_rehearsal.restored: The lab was returned to its original packages (qsm-pve-direct 0.4.0+shared3 with its own diversion, stock qemu-server/pve-container/libpve-guest-common, the patched pve-manager) and stopped.

checks_on_the_node_after_install: CT 147 QSM Direct popup through standalone signalling: video in 1.8 and 2.7 s.
VM 990 with QSM Display1 (CPU) enabled through Hardware > Display: embedded + window 2/2, popup 2/2 (1.8 s). Switched off again; the config equals the one before.
VM 990 with dbus-display, the path VMs 100 and 145 use: embedded + window passes under the official UI.
qdev-host full Hardware-panel cycle on VM 990 with QSM Display1: add tb-vga, attached (01:00.0), remove.
findings: lab/proxmox9/qualify-pve-direct-browser-e2e.cjs counts the retired /api2/extjs/.../qsm-direct route and fails on every current build after the video check. The copy in tests/ counts the signal-service POST instead.
A container's QSM Direct item is enabled only after an asynchronous settings check; a click before that does nothing. Automation must wait for it.
CT consoles: two slots per container, each kept for 300 s after closing. On the native-viewer UI a refused console shows the generic 'Could not create a direct browser console.'
Removing the core disables qsm-pve-direct-signal (prerm); reinstalling the core alone does not enable it again (the standalone package does).
not_checked: A GL (virtio-gl) VM: the lab ran without VirGL, and VMs 100 and 145 on .17 were left stopped and unchanged.
Guest packages in CT 147 were not updated.
Version numbers exp224-exp227 are local to this work; they may collide with numbers chosen later in the main qsm sequence.
